	TConf.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
	TMain.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
	TMain.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	Tog.Visible, Lb.Visible = false, false
	SpeedIn.Visible, JumpIn.Visible, ClickDelayIn.Visible = true, true, true
end)

-- Lógica de Configurações de Atributos do Jogador
SpeedIn.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local val = tonumber(SpeedIn.Text)
	if val and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = val
	end
end)

JumpIn.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local val = tonumber(JumpIn.Text)
	if val and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
		player.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = val
		player.Character.Humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
	end
end)

-- Lógica Interna de Automação do Auto Clicker Gato
local auto = false
local gato = nil
local delayClique = 0.01

ClickDelayIn.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local val = tonumber(ClickDelayIn.Text)
	if val then delayClique = val end
end)

local function acharGato()
	if gato and gato.Parent then return gato end
	for _, o in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if o:IsA("ClickDetector") then
			local n = string.lower(o.Parent.Name)
			if string.find(n,"cat") or string.find(n,"gato") or string.find(n,"leader") or string.find(n,"clic") then
				gato = o
				return o
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function loop(alvo)
	local cx = (getconnections and getconnections(alvo.MouseClick)) or {}
	while auto and alvo and alvo.Parent do
		if #cx > 0 then
			for _, c in pairs(cx) do c:Fire() end
		else
			fireclickdetector(alvo)
		end
		task.wait(delayClique)
	end
end

Tog.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	auto = not auto
	if auto then
		Tog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
		Tog.Text = "AUTO CLIQUE: LIGADO"
		Lb.Text = "Status: Procurando Alvo..."
		local tgt = acharGato()
		if tgt then
			Lb.Text = "Status: Metralhando com sucesso! 🔥"
			Lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
			task.spawn(loop, tgt)
			task.spawn(loop, tgt)
		else
			Lb.Text = "Status: Gato não encontrado."
			Lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
			auto = false
			Tog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
			Tog.Text = "AUTO CLIQUE: DESLIGADO"
		end
	else
		Tog.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
		Tog.Text = "AUTO CLIQUE: DESLIGADO"
		Lb.Text = "Status: Parado"
		Lb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
	end
end)

scripts.title: AutoFarm Open Source
scripts.script:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local fld = workspace["b\007\010\007\010\007"]
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local old = root.CFrame
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
    5,
    Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
    Enum.EasingDirection.Out
)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").AFK
        Event:FireServer(true)
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj:IsA("Seat") or obj:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
        obj:Destroy()
    end
end

for _, obj in ipairs(fld:GetDescendants()) do
    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        local tween = TweenService:Create(root, tweenInfo, {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(obj.Position)
        })
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Wait()
        task.wait(1)
    end
end

local returnTween = TweenService:Create(root, tweenInfo, {
    CFrame = old
})
returnTween:Play()
returnTween.Completed:Wait()

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- ANTI SLIP
humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,false)
humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,false)

-- MAIN ANIMATION
local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://91409825184210"

local track = humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim)
track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
track.Looped = true

-- DOUBLE JUMP ANIMATION
local jumpAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
jumpAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://476778305"

local jumpTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(jumpAnim)
jumpTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4

local canDouble = false
local usedDouble = false

-- NO STUN
local function removeStun()

	for _,v in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		
		local name = string.lower(v.Name)

		if name:find("stun")
		or name:find("freeze")
		or name:find("ragdoll") then

local function playChaosEmeraldIntro(callback)

	local chaosEmeraldsId = 127338011222921

	local success, objects =
		pcall(game.GetObjects, game, "rbxassetid://" .. chaosEmeraldsId)

	if not success or #objects == 0 then

	chaosModel.Parent = workspace

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- ============================================================
-- SCRIPT 1: FLIGHT SYSTEM (3s) + SOFT BUTTON (40x40) + FOV 120
-- ============================================================

local FLY_SFX_ID = 118787708282878
local FLY_DURATION = 3 
local FLY_SPEED = 120
local NORMAL_FOV = 70
local MAX_FOV = 120
local isFlying = false

local sfx = Instance.new("Sound", humanoidRootPart)
sfx.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. FLY_SFX_ID
sfx.Volume = 1
sfx.Looped = true

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", playerGui)
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = true -- CAMBIADO A TRUE: El botón desaparece al morir/respawnear

local flyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", screenGui)
flyBtn.Name = "SoftFlyButton"
flyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
flyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.5, 0)
flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
flyBtn.Text = ""
flyBtn.Rotation = 45

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", flyBtn)
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", flyBtn)
uiStroke.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 1)
uiStroke.Thickness = 2
uiStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

local function tweenFOV(target)
    local info = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(camera, info, {FieldOfView = target}):Play()
end

local bv, bg, renderConn

local function stopFlying()
    isFlying = false
    if bv then bv:Destroy() end
    if bg then bg:Destroy() end
    if renderConn then renderConn:Disconnect() end
    sfx:Stop()
    humanoid.PlatformStand = false
    flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    tweenFOV(NORMAL_FOV)
end

local function startFlying()
    if isFlying then return end
    isFlying = true
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    tweenFOV(MAX_FOV)
    
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", humanoidRootPart)
    bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.huge
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro", humanoidRootPart)
    bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * math.huge
    sfx:Play()

    renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if isFlying and bv and bg then
            if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                bv.Velocity = camera.CFrame.LookVector * FLY_SPEED
            else
                bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end
            bg.CFrame = camera.CFrame
        end
    end)

    task.delay(FLY_DURATION, function()
        stopFlying()
    end)
end

flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startFlying)

    humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    stopFlying()
    sfx.Parent = humanoidRootPart
    camera.FieldOfView = NORMAL_FOV
end)

scripts.script:
-- ========================================================
-- SCRIPT: MULTI-LENGTH SHORT WORDS + 2 RANDOM BONUS SLOTS
-- SCHEMA: 2, 3, 4, 5, 5, 6 LETTERE + 2 SLOT CASUALI (RANDOM)
-- CLICCA LA PAROLA E LA INVIA DA SOLO IN CHAT
-- ========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

if LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("StrictWordBombGui") then
    LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.StrictWordBombGui:Destroy()
end

-- --- SCARICAMENTO DIZIONARIO COMPLETO DA INTERNET ---
local WordDatabase = {}
print("[⏳] Caricamento del dizionario dall'archivio online...")

local success, result = pcall(function()
    return game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raun/Scrabble/master/words.txt")
end)

if success and result then
    for word in string.gmatch(result, "[^\r\n]+") do
        local pulita = string.upper(word)
        if #pulita >= 2 and #pulita <= 6 then
            table.insert(WordDatabase, pulita)
        end
    end
    print("[✔️] Dizionario pronto! " .. #WordDatabase .. " parole caricate.")
else
    print("[⚠️] Errore di rete, uso archivio di emergenza.")
    WordDatabase = {"AN", "IN", "ON", "TO", "CAT", "DOG", "THE", "THAT", "THIS"}
end

-- --- CREAZIONE INTERFACCIA GRAFICA ---
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "StrictWordBombGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 420) -- Allungato per contenere gli 8 tasti totali
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 30)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
MainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 150) -- Colore Neon modificato
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local UICornerMain = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICornerMain.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
UICornerMain.Parent = MainFrame

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 15, 30)
Title.Text = "🎯 CUSTOM + RANDOM WORD BOT"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 150)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.AutoLocalize = false
Title.Parent = MainFrame

local InputBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
InputBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 35)
InputBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
InputBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45)
InputBox.Text = ""
InputBox.PlaceholderText = "Deve iniziare con..."
InputBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
InputBox.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
InputBox.TextSize = 15
InputBox.AutoLocalize = false
InputBox.Parent = MainFrame

local function creaBottoneParola(yPos, placeholder, isRandom)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 35)
    Btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
    
    if isRandom then
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 25, 60) -- Colore viola per gli slot casuali
    else
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 45)
    end
    
    Btn.Text = placeholder
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    Btn.TextSize = 14
    Btn.AutoLocalize = false
    Btn.Parent = MainFrame
    
    local UICornerBtn = Instance.new("UICorner")
    UICornerBtn.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
    UICornerBtn.Parent = Btn
    
    return Btn
end

-- Generazione dei pulsanti (6 fissi per lunghezza + 2 casuali in fondo)
local WordBtn1 = creaBottoneParola(95, "[2 Letters]", false)
local WordBtn2 = creaBottoneParola(135, "[3 Letters]", false)
local WordBtn3 = creaBottoneParola(175, "[4 Letters]", false)
local WordBtn4 = creaBottoneParola(215, "[5 Letters]", false)
local WordBtn5 = creaBottoneParola(255, "[5 Letters (2nd)]", false)
local WordBtn6 = creaBottoneParola(295, "[6 Letters]", false)
local WordBtnR1 = creaBottoneParola(335, "🎲 [Random 1]", true)
local WordBtnR2 = creaBottoneParola(375, "🎲 [Random 2]", true)

-- --- FUNZIONE DI INVIO SIMULATO ---
local bloccoInvio = false
local function digitaEInvia(parola)
    if bloccoInvio or parola == "" or string.sub(parola, 1, 1) == "[" or parola == "None" or string.find(parola, "Random") then return end
    bloccoInvio = true
    
    InputBox.Text = "" 
    
    task.spawn(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Slash, false, game)
        task.wait(0.04)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Slash, false, game)
        task.wait(0.04)
        
        for i = 1, #parola do
            local lettera = string.sub(parola, i, i)
            VirtualInputManager:SendTextInput(lettera)
        end
        task.wait(0.04)
        
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Return, false, game)
        task.wait(0.04)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Return, false, game)
        
        bloccoInvio = false
    end)
end

-- --- FILTRO DI RICERCA DIZIONARIO ---
InputBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local sillaba = string.upper(InputBox.Text)
    local lunghezzaSillaba = #sillaba
    
    if sillaba == "" then
        WordBtn1.Text = "[2 Letters]"
        WordBtn2.Text = "[3 Letters]"
        WordBtn3.Text = "[4 Letters]"
        WordBtn4.Text = "[5 Letters]"
        WordBtn5.Text = "[5 Letters (2nd)]"
        WordBtn6.Text = "[6 Letters]"
        WordBtnR1.Text = "🎲 [Random 1]"
        WordBtnR2.Text = "🎲 [Random 2]"
        return
    end
    
    local len2, len3, len4, len5, len6 = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
    local tutteLeTrovate = {} -- Per i bottoni casuali
    
    for _, parola in ipairs(WordDatabase) do
        if string.sub(parola, 1, lunghezzaSillaba) == sillaba then
            table.insert(tutteLeTrovate, parola)
            
            local l = #parola
            if l == 2 then table.insert(len2, parola)
            elseif l == 3 then table.insert(len3, parola)
            elseif l == 4 then table.insert(len4, parola)
            elseif l == 5 then table.insert(len5, parola)
            elseif l == 6 then table.insert(len6, parola)
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Assegnazione slot fissi
    WordBtn1.Text = len2[1] or "None"
    WordBtn2.Text = len3[1] or "None"
    WordBtn3.Text = len4[1] or "None"
    WordBtn4.Text = len5[1] or "None"
    WordBtn5.Text = len5[2] or "None"
    WordBtn6.Text = len6[1] or "None"
    
    -- Assegnazione slot casuali (prendiamo due indici a caso tra tutte le parole trovate)
    if #tutteLeTrovate > 0 then
        local r1 = tutteLeTrovate[math.random(1, #tutteLeTrovate)]
        local r2 = tutteLeTrovate[math.random(1, #tutteLeTrovate)]
        WordBtnR1.Text = "🎲 " .. r1
        WordBtnR2.Text = "🎲 " .. r2
    else
        WordBtnR1.Text = "None"
        WordBtnR2.Text = "None"
    end
end)

-- --- COLLEGAMENTI CLICK PULSANTI ---
WordBtn1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() digitaEInvia(WordBtn1.Text) end)
WordBtn2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() digitaEInvia(WordBtn2.Text) end)
WordBtn3.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() digitaEInvia(WordBtn3.Text) end)
WordBtn4.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() digitaEInvia(WordBtn4.Text) end)
WordBtn5.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() digitaEInvia(WordBtn5.Text) end)
WordBtn6.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() digitaEInvia(WordBtn6.Text) end)

-- Pulizia testo prima dell'invio per i bottoni random (rimuove l'icona del dado)
WordBtnR1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    local text = string.gsub(WordBtnR1.Text, "🎲 ", "")
    digitaEInvia(text) 
end)
WordBtnR2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() 
    local text = string.gsub(WordBtnR2.Text, "🎲 ", "")
    digitaEInvia(text) 
end)
